oe_romp_pontificate = {
	has_target = no

	expel_members_who_are_targets_of_other_members = no
	disband_if_no_leader = no
	max_active_resolutions = 1

	has_leader_country = yes
	leader_type = country
	leader_title_key = "OE_ROMP_PONTIFEX_MAXIMUS"
	leader_change_trigger_type = none
	leader_change_method = none

	create_visible_trigger = {
		always = no
	}

	invite_visible_trigger = {
		always = yes
	}

	can_initiate_policy_votes = {
		is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
	}

	can_declare_war = {
		always = yes
	}

	variables = {
		religion = {
			format = "RELIGION_FORMAT"
			start = religion:hellenism_religion
		}
	}

	laws = {
		oe_romp_io_sacred_calendar_law = oe_romp_io_cal_julian_fasti
	}

	modifier = {
		tolerance_own = 0.5
		stability_cost_efficiency = 0.08
	}

	leader_modifier = {
		monthly_religious_influence = 0.1
		monthly_prestige = 0.08
		omen_time_modifier = 0.1
	}

	can_lead_trigger = {
		religion = religion:hellenism_religion
	}

	can_join_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		religion = religion:hellenism_religion
	}

	can_leave_trigger = {
		always = no
	}

	auto_leave_trigger = {
		NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
	}

	auto_disband_trigger = {
		always = no
	}

	on_creation = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:actor }
			set_leader_country = scope:actor
		}
	}

	on_joined = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = religion }
						NOT = { exists = var:religion }
					}
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				set_variable = {
					name = religion
					value = religion:hellenism_religion
				}
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			var:religion = {
				add_international_organization = scope:recipient
			}
		}
	}

	on_left = {
	}

	ai_desire_to_join = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				religion = religion:hellenism_religion
			}
			add = {
				desc = "WE_WANT_THE_ORGANIZATION_TO_GROW"
				value = 50
			}
		}
	}

	ai_desire_to_allow_new_member = {
		add = {
			desc = "WE_WANT_THE_ORGANIZATION_TO_GROW"
			value = 25
		}
	}
